@pytest.mark.sphinx('html', testroot='ext-autodoc')
def test_autodoc_inherited_members_attributes(app):
    options = {"members": None,
               "inherited-members": None}
    actual = do_autodoc(app, 'class', 'target.inherited_attrs.Derived', options)
    assert list(actual) == [
        '',
        '.. py:class:: Derived()',
        '   :module: target.inherited_attrs',
        '',
        '',
        '   .. py:attribute:: Derived.attr1',
        '      :module: target.inherited_attrs',
        "      :value: 'a'",
        '',
        '      docstring of attr1',
        '',
        '',
        '   .. py:attribute:: Derived.attr2',
        '      :module: target.inherited_attrs',
        '',
        '      docstring of attr2',
        '',
    ]

    actual = do_autodoc(app, 'class', 'target.inherited_attrs.Derived', {"members": None})
    assert 'attr1' not in '\n'.join(actual)
EOF
